name: Ancient Ferrous Metallurgy Sites of Burkina Faso
description: Scattered across five locations in Burkina Faso, these ancient ironworking sites preserve tall clay smelting furnaces, old mines and traces of dwellings. Douroula, the oldest, dates to around 800 BCE, while the others show how iron production expanded in the last thousand years or so. Village blacksmiths still make tools here and take part in local rituals.
